args.title: Fix deduplication for overlapping statements
args.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

The deduplication logic currently misses overlapping days when two statements are uploaded consecutively. The file should be modified to account for this case by ensuring that overlapping dates are checked properly and added to the set of seen keys immediately.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The deduplication logic in `src/ingest/dedupe.ts` misses overlapping days when two statements are uploaded consecutively. To fix this, the logic should ensure overlapping dates are verified properly and added to the set of seen keys immediately.
